# <span id="aanchor211"></span> Data Map Editor

The Data Map Editor allows the user to set up and save data mappings between TESTit and FLOWCAL fields to be used during imports of test reports with TESTit 2 Integrated. This feature is useful in determining if a TESTit value should update a FLOWCAL value on import or generate an exception. For example, by mapping the TESTit meter name to the FLOWCAL meter name, the FLOWCAL meter name will be updated during the import of TESTit data.

By default, none of the fields are mapped.

This functionality is only available with TESTit 2 Integrated.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Data Map Editor: 

Go to **Setup** \> **TESTit Manager**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 726;height: 464;" />

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Details">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Data Map Editor Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following items are available on the Data Map Editor screen:

- **Default Mapping** - A change to the Default Mapping will affect all meters or sources. The user can create additional data maps that can be used on specific sources or meters as defined by the user.
- **Create Meters Pending** - Meters that are created as a result of a test report import will be created with a Business Status of Pending New. Meter Status is not affected by this option. If a meter is created by TESTit import, Meter Status will default to Active.
- **New** - Create a new data map. A new map cannot be named "Default Mapping." Once a new mapping has been created, a folder with the same name will be created in the TESTit import path defined within Service Configuration.
- **Save** - Save changes.
- **Cancel** - Cancel edits and do not save changes.
- **Exit** - Exit the Data Map Editor screen.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Table Objects">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Table Objects</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Table Objects">

There are four FLOWCAL table objects within the Data Map Editor: Meter, GQ Source, Contact, and Company. A table object can be configured to Report, Create, or Ignore within the Update column.

- The **Report** option will create a system message when an object (e.g., meter, source, contact, or company) is encountered that did not exist during a TESTit import. The object will not be created in FLOWCAL.
- The **Create** option will create the object in FLOWCAL if it does not exist.
- The **Ignore** option will ignore the object and will not create a system message.

#### Meter and GQ Source

TESTit fields can be mapped to FLOWCAL fields within the Meter and GQ Source table objects. The left side of the grid contains TESTit fields and the right side contains FLOWCAL fields.

<div class="procedure">

To map a field:

1.  Expand the table associated objects.
2.  Drag and drop a TESTit field from the left to a FLOWCAL field on the right.
3.  Check the **Compare** checkbox to create an exception when the TESTit field value differs from the FLOWCAL field value.
4.  Select an option from the Update drop-down list.

> The Update options are Values Only, Values & NULL, and Ignore.
>
> - The **Values Only** option will not copy over null values. A value must exist.
> - The **Values & Null** option will copy over values including null values.
> - The **Ignore** option will ignore the imported value and is often used in conjunction with the Compare checkbox. When combined, a system message will be created when the values differ, but the data in FLOWCAL will not be modified.

1.  Click **Save**.

</div>

TSX files to be imported should be placed in the folder that corresponds to the appropriate data map. To use the Default Mapping, place the files in the TESTit import path configured within Service Configuration.

#### Contact and Company

This feature is no longer supported.

</div>
